purpose: This table provides cleaned hourly weather observations (temperature, humidity, wind, pressure, precipitation, and visibility) for NYC-area airports (EWR, JFK, LGA) for downstream joins against flight or operational tables keyed by origin airport and hour.
usage: Join on origin and time_hour to attach weather conditions to events at that airport and hour; consumers must handle nulls in wind_dir, wind_speed, wind_gust, and pressure explicitly since these columns are retained nullable rather than imputed, and should be aware wind_gust is null in the large majority of rows.
limitations: The cleanup did not resolve the very high null rate in wind_gust (0.745505) or the moderate null rate in pressure (0.114953); these columns remain sparsely populated and any aggregate relying on them should account for missingness. The dataset covers only the single year 2013 per the constant year column, so it cannot support multi-year trend analysis without additional bronze loads.
